title: ControlDefinition
description: controls/*.psd1 (serialized to JSON for schema validation) -- engineering plan section 9.1's full field list. ADR-013: a control cannot supply a scriptblock, path, expression, or dynamic module -- evaluatorFunctionName only ever names a statically-bound function compiled into the module by the build.

controlId.description: Immutable stable ID, e.g. 'XTA-001'. Never reused for a semantically different control even if retired.

version.description: Monotonic per-control semantic version (section 18), independent of the module/schema/registry versions.

severity.description: 1=Low .. 4=Critical, matching the severity scale already in use across the feature-parity matrix's designed controls.

ownership.description: Internal team/owner accountable for this control's results, per ADR-001's internal-ownership-domain rationale (e.g. 'Security Ops' for Conditional Access controls).

requiredEvidenceDomains.description: Which entity/relationship domains this control's evaluator reads.

confirmed.description: Whether this scope was directly confirmed against Microsoft Graph/Azure documentation (as opposed to assumed by analogy) -- see 00-open-questions.md's permission-scope closure pass for why this field exists: several controls originally shipped with unconfirmed assumed scopes, two of which turned out to be wrong.

applicability.description: The condition under which this control produces a result at all (vs. NotApplicable).

resultStatus.description: Duplicated (not $ref'd) from control-result.schema.json's status enum deliberately -- cross-file $ref resolution is not exercised/guaranteed by this project's schema-validation wrapper (Test-EntraPostureSchema), so the two enums are kept in sync by the Contract test suite (tests/Contract/SchemaConsistency.Tests.ps1) instead of by schema composition.

expectedResultSemantics.description: Prose specification of exactly when this control returns each technical status -- the authoritative definition reason codes must agree with.

evaluatorFunctionName.description: Name of the statically-bound evaluator function (ADR-013). The build fails if this name does not resolve to a real function declared in the module's source order.

evidenceRedactionPolicy.description: Minimum redaction mode this control's evidence supports without losing actionability, per section 10.2's export modes.

disposition.description: Section 2's disposition taxonomy. The Phase 9 license-provenance audit (00-open-questions.md section 1) checks this field specifically for the four downgraded rights-holder outreach items -- 'Reuse'/'Adopt' without an attached written approval record is a release blocker.

sourceProject.description: Explicit null when disposition is 'Reimplement' with no source-tool prior art (e.g. a clean-room control authored directly from Microsoft documentation).

baselineDependency.description: ADR-035: required (non-null) when this control compares tenant state against a Microsoft-defined default/baseline; explicit null otherwise.

citationStrength.description: Matches the citation-strength grading discipline already established across the designed controls (direct quote strongest, inference weakest, explicitly flagged as such).
